artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New AST census over lib/research: flags any glob.glob/iglob, fnmatch.fnmatch/fnmatchcase/filter or <Path>.glob/rglob call whose pattern argument is built (directly, via f-string, %, +, .format, or os.path.join) from a name or attribute containing 'security_key' or ending '_key'. `python -m lib.research.corpus.key_glob_census` prints 'glob_sites <n> key_derived <k> files_scanned <f>' plus one 'key_derived_site <path>:<line> <call>' line per flagged call, exit 0 iff key_derived==0. `--plant` writes one key-derived-glob module into a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory (never inside the repo), scans only that dir, prints 'plant_flagged 1'.

New file, 17 tests: one call-form (glob.glob, glob.iglob, fnmatch.fnmatch/fnmatchcase/filter, Path.glob, Path.rglob) crossed with each key-derivation form (bare name, f-string, %, +, .format, os.path.join) that is key-derived is flagged; a constant pattern and a non-key variable pattern are not flagged; a key-derived name passed as the non-pattern argument is not flagged; the --plant positive control flags via run_plant() and via main(['--plant']); main() over a scratch root prints the summary line. All 17 pass.
